user.title: PowerLink controller
user.description: Enter the Home Assistant base URL the PowerPlay devices can reach. Local HTTP is permitted only on a private network; use HTTPS for cross-network handoffs. Plex server credentials are optional and remain inside Home Assistant.

error.invalid_settings: Supply valid accessible URLs and both Plex fields or neither.

register_device.name: Register device
register_device.description: Set resolution policy, launch method and wake routine.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Existing Home Assistant media player entity.

launch_script.name: Launch script
launch_script.description: Script entity to receive powerlink_uri variable.

wake_steps.name: Wake steps
wake_steps.description: Optional ordered service, delay and wait_state actions.

open_device.name: Open device
open_device.description: Wake and launch PowerPlay without a handoff.

prepare_handoff.name: Prepare handoff
prepare_handoff.description: Prepare an exact queue manifest without waking the destination.

snapshot.name: Snapshot
snapshot.description: PowerPlay v1 ordered playback queue snapshot.

handoff.name: Handoff
handoff.description: Execute a prepared handoff to a v1-capable PowerPlay device.

menu_options.discover_devices: Find Fire TV / Android TV devices

menu_option_descriptions.discover_devices: Find media players already available in Home Assistant; no network scan or new ADB connection.
menu_option_descriptions.manual_device: Choose another media player or a custom remote bridge.
menu_option_descriptions.edit_device: Update resolution, quality, launch method, URL or power-on behavior.
menu_option_descriptions.advanced_wake: Edit a multi-step wake routine in the object editor.
menu_option_descriptions.remove_device: Unregister a device from PowerLink only.
menu_option_descriptions.pair_player: Generate a one-time pairing code for a registered Fire TV. No Home Assistant access token is needed.
menu_option_descriptions.powershuffle: Review tracked series, cycle progress, and reset or clear skips.

discover_devices.title: Discovered Home Assistant devices
discover_devices.description: Choose an existing Android TV / Fire TV media player to add. Devices already registered with PowerLink are hidden.

manual_device.title: Add device manually
manual_device.description: Choose a media_player or remote entity already set up in Home Assistant. Remote entities generally require a custom launch script.

device_settings.title: Device settings
device_settings.description: Configure {device}. PowerLink does not automatically verify display resolution or PowerPlay protocol support. Keep v1 protocol disabled until PowerPlay 1.3.0+ has been tested on this device. For complex power-on steps, use the advanced wake editor.

data.name: Device name
data.launch_script: Launch script (only if using a script)

advanced_wake.title: Choose a device for advanced wake editing

wake_steps.title: Advanced wake routine
wake_steps.description: Edit the ordered wake_steps list for {device}. Each step can be a Home Assistant service, delay, or wait_state operation. Validation and time limits apply; an empty list disables wake steps. Direct script.<name> service calls wait for completion; script.turn_on does not.

confirm_remove.title: Confirm device removal
confirm_remove.description: Unregister {device} from PowerLink? This does not delete the Home Assistant device or entity and can be reversed by adding it again.

pair_player.title: Pair a PowerPlay device
pair_player.description: Select the registered Fire Stick you are setting up. Enable the verified PowerLink v1 option on that device first.

show_pair_code.title: Enter this code on your Fire Stick
show_pair_code.description: On **{device}** open **PowerPlay → Settings → PowerLink**, enter your Home Assistant URL and pairing code **{code}**. The code expires after 3 minutes and can be used once. Select Submit when finished.

powershuffle.title: Choose a tracked PowerShuffle show
powershuffle.description: Tracked shows are registered automatically when PowerPlay starts PowerShuffle.

powershuffle_manage.title: PowerShuffle cycle controls
powershuffle_manage.description: {show} ({profile}) is on cycle {cycle} at {percent}% complete, with {deferred} next-cycle deferrals and {cooling} five-day skips. Changes are permanent and cannot be undone.

data.confirm: I understand this changes PowerShuffle history

error.invalid_device: Check the device settings, URL, launch script and wake routine.
error.invalid_wake_steps: Invalid wake routine. Use a list of supported service, delay or wait_state steps.
error.device_unavailable: This Home Assistant entity is no longer available.
error.already_registered: This device is already registered with PowerLink.
error.confirm_required: Check the confirmation box before unregistering the device.
error.powershuffle_active: Stop active PowerShuffle playback before changing history.

abort.controller_not_ready: PowerLink is not loaded. Reload the integration and try again.
abort.no_devices_found: No new compatible Fire TV / Android TV entities were found. Use Add manually to choose an existing entity.
abort.no_verified_devices: Enable verified PowerLink v1 for a registered device before pairing.
abort.no_powershuffle_shows: No shows have used PowerShuffle yet. Start it from a show's detail page in PowerPlay.
abort.powershuffle_show_not_found: This PowerShuffle show could not be found.
